eligibility_rule: Resolve base + extension + revision overlay first. Only the resolved current family is eligible for new products; approval_status must be APPROVED and superseded_by must be null. DRAFT_REVIEW families are visible for teacher review but are not runtime-eligible.
runtime_authoring_rule: Question structure and wording are fixed by family template. Runtime may only instantiate declared parameters/number swaps and approved representation rendering. It may not invent or paraphrase a new question.
graph_rule: Cartesian graphs normally use the approved graph tool / graph rendering contract. Teacher-directed local graph exceptions must be explicit in the family representation route.
stale_version_rule: Downstream builders and PMs must resolve FAMILY_REVISIONS.json and may not author from stale base/extension wording when a revision exists.
